overview: Hosts Danielle Balocca and Chelli Keshavan spoke with restaurateur Alvaro Sandoval, his son Mateo, and America's Test Kitchen deputy food editor Bryan Roof about the Sandoval family's Medford restaurants. The conversation covered the history and culinary philosophy of Tenoch, El Tacuba, and Localito, as well as plans for their upcoming Spanish Mediterranean restaurant, Ultramarinos Tardeo.

items.title: Guest introductions
items.summary: Danielle Balocca and Chelli Keshavan introduce restaurateurs Alvaro and Mateo Sandoval alongside Bryan Roof of America's Test Kitchen.

items.title: Founding of Tenoch and culinary approach
items.summary: Alvaro Sandoval describes transitioning from construction to opening Tenoch in Medford Square 15 years ago and maintaining authentic Mexican recipes without tailoring dishes to outside palates.

items.title: El Tacuba concept and family recipes
items.summary: Alvaro and Mateo Sandoval discuss the sit-down atmosphere at El Tacuba and how the menu incorporates Veracruz regional traditions and family recipes.

items.title: Plans for Ultramarinos Tardeo
items.summary: The Sandovals announce their upcoming Medford Square restaurant, Ultramarinos Tardeo, describing its Spanish Mediterranean focus and integrated specialty retail counter.

items.title: Medford Square business dynamics and hospitality
items.summary: The discussion examines how events at the Chevalier Theatre drive local business and why the owners prioritize customer service and personality when hiring staff.

items.title: Design, self-renovation, and ingredient sourcing
items.summary: Alvaro and Mateo Sandoval explain how their family designs and builds their restaurant interiors directly and shares their process for sourcing specialty coffee from Veracruz for Localito.
